clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Tirisfal, Faol's Rest lies neglected southwest of the Scarlet Monastery. The gravesite holds the tomb of Archbishop Alonsus Faol, founder of the Knights of the Silver Hand. Beneath the blighted canopy, it is now a resting place for spirits who perish near the monastery.

Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, mourners traveled to Faol's Rest to honor Archbishop Alonsus Faol. He led the Church of the Holy Light through the dark days of the Second War and founded the paladins to protect humanity. Faol died peacefully before the Scourge arrived, spared the agony of seeing his kingdom fall. In those years, mourners journeyed up the road from Capital City to leave offerings and pay their respects to the beloved patriarch.

The Plague of Undeath withered Tirisfal, and the pilgrims stopped coming. Now the monument lies abandoned and cracked beneath the Scarlet Monastery's high bluffs. Wild brush has reclaimed the pathways, and the tomb rests amid damp mist. Those who fall near the monastery or elsewhere in Tirisfal find a quiet place here to gather their spirits before returning to the dangers around them.
